<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="orangeHeader" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F99855"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F97C25"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="whiteFade" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <circle cx="326" cy="54" r="72" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="188" r="92" fill="#FDC125" opacity="0.12"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="112" x2="92" y2="112" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.7"/>
  <line x1="298" y1="143" x2="366" y2="143" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.45"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>

  <text x="28" y="128" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="34.4" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign In To Sandow</text>
  <text x="28" y="158" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="18.35" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Personalize your daily inspiration.</text>

  <!-- form card shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="20" y="190" width="350" height="506" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="20" y="186" width="350" height="506" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- email field -->
  <text x="40" y="222" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#111214">Email address</text>
  <rect x="38" y="232" width="314" height="56" rx="8" fill="#F3F3F4" stroke="#BABBBE" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="255" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <polyline points="54,256 61,261 68,256" fill="none" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="82" y="262" font-family="Lato, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#696F79">you@example.com</text>
  <text x="40" y="307" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="300" fill="#696F79">Use the email connected to your account.</text>

  <!-- password field -->
  <text x="40" y="343" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#111214">Password</text>
  <rect x="38" y="353" width="314" height="56" rx="8" fill="#F3F3F4" stroke="#BABBBE" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="54" y="371" width="14" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <polyline points="57,371 57,367 60,364 64,364 67,367 67,371" fill="none" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="377" r="1.5" fill="#F68A1D"/>

  <circle cx="329" cy="381" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="375" x2="335" y2="387" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="40" y="435" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#F68A1D">Forgot Password?</text>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="38" y="456" width="314" height="56" rx="19" fill="#393C43"/>
    <text x="177" y="490" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign In</text>
    <polyline points="291,484 297,490 291,496" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="281" y1="490" x2="297" y2="490" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- account link -->
  <text x="195" y="542" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#696F79">Don’t have an account?</text>
  <text x="195" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#F68A1D">Sign Up</text>

  <!-- divider -->
  <line x1="40" y1="589" x2="145" y2="589" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="594" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#696F79">Or</text>
  <line x1="245" y1="589" x2="350" y2="589" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="38" y="610" width="96" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#BABBBE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="632" r="8" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="629" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="57" y="633" width="8" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="88" y="637" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Apple</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="147" y="610" width="96" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#BABBBE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="169" cy="632" r="9" fill="#F97316"/>
    <text x="169" y="638" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="217" y="637" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="256" y="610" width="96" height="44" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#BABBBE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="278" cy="632" r="9" fill="#FDC125"/>

    <text x="321" y="637" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#373737">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- lower fade and navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="700" width="390" height="78" fill="url(#whiteFade)"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="762" x2="366" y2="762" stroke="#F3F3F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g opacity="0.72">
    <polygon points="48,790 58,781 68,790 68,801 48,801" fill="none" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="48,790 58,781 68,790" fill="none" stroke="#F68A1D" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="58" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#696F79">Home</text>

    <circle cx="142" cy="789" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="148" y1="795" x2="154" y2="801" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="142" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#696F79">Explore</text>

    <circle cx="239" cy="786" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="239" cy="799" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="239" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#696F79">Profile</text>

    <rect x="316" y="782" width="15" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="787" x2="327" y2="787" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="792" x2="327" y2="792" stroke="#696F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="324" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#696F79">More</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="150" y="832" width="90" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000" opacity="0.75"/>
